name: Tsukumo Chiyo
source: The manifestation of the concept of Tsukumogami, the Japanese idea of souls residing within objects.  She is a giving young woman who desires intensely to be 'used'.  Because she is the manifestation of the concept of Tsukumogami in general, she can converse with them regardless of distance.  She runs a small Japanese-style restaurant on the outside of town.
